notes.title: Update for January 30, 2025.
notes.content:
* Added to TENTEN-kun's death animation when he is hit by a ball dropped by a light bulb and when his time is up.

* Fixed a bug related to the display of extended ROOM rankings and records.

notes.title: Update on January 25, 2025
notes.content:
The new mode allows you to play 8 stages created by Yui Tensho, an actress, voice actress, and professional female wrestler.
　You can play them by selecting Option → Appendix → Additional stages → Yui Tenshow.

notes.title: Mar.30th.2024 Update!
notes.content:
* A new achievement, "Meet Mr. Pearl-On," has been added.
* Fixed a problem in which the volume was set to 0 when the game was started with the old saved data.
* Added an explanation about the fact that you cannot select the 41st and subsequent levels unless you have a certain item at the start of the game.

notes.title: Mar.30th.2024 Update!
notes.content:
* Various settings are now saved.
* The input method for name entry can now be selected from "Options" → "Game Settings". If you select "Arcade", you can select a letter by pressing the up and down arrow buttons, and press the X or A button to select the letter.
* Three new achievements have been added.

notes.title: Mar.21st.2024 version
notes.content:
* When the game starts, the jingle can be skipped by pressing the START button/ESC key.

* When a player clears a level, the START button/ESC key can now be used to immediately move to the next level.

* When a player dies or clears a face while a block is generated, the block that is still generating will remain.

* Fixed a problem in which the game advances to the 51st and subsequent levels when the entire game is cleared.

* If a player does not own an item necessary to clear the game, he/she will not be able to continue to a certain level. Items required to clear the game will return to the state where you do not have them after clearing the game or restarting it.

notes.title: Mar.18th.2024 Version
notes.content:
* Unlimitedmode is implemented, in which the score is reduced to zero at the start of each game face, instead of decreasing the remaining plane even if the player dies.
　This mode can be selected from "Options" -> "Game Settings".
* Fixed some problems in the title screen.
* Fixed a problem with TELTEL name entry.
* Fixed a problem with pause.
